# PerchTV 0.1.24

OK no longer stops live TV.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Pressing OK on the remote while a live channel plays now leaves it playing. Live TV cannot be paused, and OK used to stop it. Press Back, or Stop on the phone, to end a channel. OK still pauses and resumes films and episodes.
- The list that holding OK opens now has the screen to itself on the waiting screen, so the text behind it no longer shows through.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Up to eight phones, the list of paired phones, Voice Guide and captions on Samsung televisions.
